SELECT  
	SaleLedgerLogID=99999999999,
	invcode     = saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	altersaleinvcode = saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	date        = saleledger.date,    
	flatdisc    = saleledger.flatdisc, 
	salestax    = saleledger.salestax,       
	misccharges = saleledger.misccharges, 
	invdiscperc = saleledger.discperc, 
	invgstperc1 = saleledger.invgstperc1, 
	posted = saleledger.posted,
	saletype = (Select Name From SaleType Where saletypecode = Max(saleledger.saletypecode) ) ,
	accounts.name, 
	amount =  Sum ( saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice),   
	gross= Sum ( saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice), 
	itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (Round(( saledetail.looseqty  * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (saledetail.looseqty  * saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2),    
	invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( saledetail.looseqty   * (saledetail.saleprice  - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (saleledger.discperc /100),
	salesman = CASE WHEN saleledger.modifycounter > 0 THEN (select u.username from users u where u.usercode = saleledger.modifiedby) ELSE users.username END,
	totaldiscount= Round(Sum (Round(( saledetail.looseqty  * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (saledetail.looseqty  * saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( saledetail.looseqty   * (saledetail.saleprice  - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (saleledger.discperc /100), 2) + saleledger.flatdisc,
	difference= Sum ( saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.saleprice) - sum(Round(saledetail.rate,2) * saledetail.looseqty) ,
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (saledetail.looseqty * saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=saleledger.accountfor,
	impactinventory=saleledger.impactinventory,
	NetAmt = dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(saleledger.saleinvcode),
	CashReceived = ISNULL(saleledger.Amt, 0) + ISNULL(CashCharged, 0),
	CreditCardCharged = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = saleledger.SaleInvCode), 0),
	SaleLedger.ModifyCounter,
	saleperson = (select sm.Name from salesman sm where sm.salesmancode = saleledger.smancode)
FROM 
	saleledger, 
	saledetail,   
	accounts,
	users  
WHERE 
	( saleledger.modifycounter > 0 ) AND
	( saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
	( saleledger.custcode = accounts.acccode ) and  
	( saleledger.salesmancode = users.usercode ) and  
	( saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.date,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.discperc,  
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	saleledger.salecatcode, 
	saleledger.posted, 
	saleledger.accountfor,
	saleledger.impactinventory,
	saleledger.modifiedby,
	saleledger.modifycounter,
	saleledger.Amt,
	saleledger.CashCharged,
	accounts.name,
	users.username,
	saleledger.smancode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	SaleLedgerLogID=99999999999,
	invcode     = saleledger.saleinvcode,    
	altersaleinvcode = saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	date        = saleledger.date,

GROUP BY

	saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	saleledger.date,   
	saleledger.misccharges,   
	saleledger.flatdisc,   
	saleledger.discperc,  
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
	saleledger.salecatcode,

	saleledger.modifycounter,
	saleledger.impactinventory,
	saleledger.Amt,
	saleledger.CashCharged,
	accounts.name,
	users.username,
	saleledger.smancode

	salesman = CASE WHEN saleledgerlog.modifycounter > 0 THEN (select u.username from users u where u.usercode = saleledgerlog.modifiedby) ELSE users.username END,
	totaldiscount= Round(Sum (Round(( saledetaillog.looseqty  * (saledetaillog.saleprice - saledetaillog.itemflatdisc) * (saledetaillog.discperc * .01)) + (saledetaillog.looseqty  * saledetaillog.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( saledetaillog.looseqty   * (saledetaillog.saleprice  - saledetaillog.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (saledetaillog.discperc * .01))) * (saleledgerlog.discperc /100), 2) + saleledgerlog.flatdisc,
	difference= Sum ( saledetaillog.looseqty * saledetaillog.saleprice) - sum(Round(saledetaillog.rate,2) * saledetaillog.looseqty) ,
	itemsalestax = Sum (Round (saledetaillog.looseqty * saledetaillog.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (saledetaillog.looseqty * (saledetaillog.saleprice - saledetaillog.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - saledetaillog.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * saledetaillog.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
	accountfor=saleledgerlog.accountfor,

	CashReceived = ISNULL(saleledgerlog.Amt, 0) + ISNULL(SaleLedgerLog.CashCharged, 0),
	CreditCardCharged = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CW.Amount) FROM CashierWindow CW WHERE CW.SaleInvCode = saleledgerlog.SaleInvCode), 0),
